rationale: The current 1.84 summary weather widget shares leaves with the nested summary editor; Rollup moved them into the View root and mangled its raw-URL retry exports. Keep those shared leaves outside the root and validate the existing View retry ABI during bundle generation.

summary.ru: Retry сводной панели восстанавливает настоящий чанк после временной ошибки загрузки.
summary.en: Summary Retry recovers the production chunk after a temporary load failure.
